name: Reed
overview: The Bible portrays reeds primarily as fragile water plants, often used figuratively to symbolize weakness and instability, as seen in 1 Kings 14:15 where Israel is likened to a reed shaken in the water. Reeds also serve practical purposes, such as measuring devices of six cubits. Notably, reeds appear in the context of Jesus' suffering, mockingly given to Him as a symbol of royalty and used to strike Him, underscoring His humility and the frailty of earthly power. Passages like Isaiah 36:6 and 2 Kings 18:21 emphasize the danger of relying on a 'broken reed,' illustrating the unreliability of trusting in human strength or alliances instead of God.
